prompt: Create a vertical anime-style portrait illustration of a quiet androgynous young person in a deep indigo night scene, shown from the chest up in a close, intimate crop. The character has cool blue-black layered bangs covering much of the forehead and one eye, a long thick side braid over the right shoulder tied near the end, pale skin, delicate eyelashes, downcast blue eyes, and a melancholy, serene expression as they lean toward a flower near their lips. Dress them in a dark blue kimono or robe with simple folded collar lines and subtle shadowed fabric folds. Surround the face with exactly 5 luminous blue lotus-like flowers: 1 large flower directly in front of the mouth and nose, 1 large flower at the lower left foreground, 1 partial flower on the far left edge, 1 flower in the upper right corner, and 1 smaller flower on the mid-right background; also include exactly 2 unopened buds near the lower-left stems. Use intense blue monochrome lighting with glowing cyan highlights, dark navy shadows, strong rim light from the upper right, translucent layered petals, golden-yellow stamens, fine hair strands, and crisp anime cel shading blended with painterly gradients. Composition should feel poetic and nocturnal, with the character partially hidden by flowers, high detail in hair and petals, shallow depth of field, no text, no watermark, no border.

promptZh: 创作一张竖版动漫风格肖像插画，主角是 一位安静的中性化年轻人，场景设定在深靛色的夜晚，采用近距离、亲密的胸部以上构图。角色拥有 冷蓝黑色 的层次感刘海，遮住大部分额头和一只眼睛；右肩垂下一条厚实的长侧辫，并在末端系好；皮肤苍白，睫毛精致，低垂的蓝色双眼流露出忧郁而宁静的神情，正向唇边的一朵花倾身。为角色穿上一件深蓝色和服或长袍，领口线条简洁，布料褶皱阴影细腻。在脸部周围环绕 5 朵发光的蓝色莲花：1 朵大花位于口鼻正前方，1 朵大花位于左下角前景，1 朵残花位于最左侧边缘，1 朵花位于右上角，1 朵较小的花位于中右侧背景；此外，在左下方的花茎附近包含 2 个未绽放的花苞。使用强烈的蓝色单色光，搭配发光的青色高光、深海军蓝阴影、来自右上方的强烈轮廓光，展现半透明的层叠花瓣、金黄色的花蕊、细腻的发丝，以及融合了绘画渐变的清晰动漫赛璐珞阴影。构图应具有诗意和夜色感，角色被花朵部分遮挡，头发和花瓣细节丰富，具有浅景深效果，无文字，无水印，无边框。
